notes:
DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the PythonObjectDriver helper was not used. The upstream TLBC2 methods are ctypes calls that return a ViStatus code and write results through output pointers (TLBC2.py:494-505), so the package is a direct Driver over a production adapter (native.py) that owns the ctypes conversion; the upstream method names and output-parameter order are preserved and the fake mirrors the adapter surface. The hardware backend .native:connect loads the pinned TLBC2.py (option module_dir, else PYTHONPATH) and opens the first available profiler or the given resource_name; it was never run. A live backend needs Windows, the Thorlabs Beam SDK DLL and the IVI VISA runtime (TLBC2_sample_2D_output.py:34); deployment must validate DLL loading, resource discovery, the raw image byte order/format and the concurrency of close() during an in-flight DLL getter. closeSDK is called in teardown. The fake is a deterministic in-memory stand-in, not a recording and not the upstream simulator; its 8 x 8 frame and all other values are placeholders. The real image is the ROI width by height of sensor pixels with 1 or 2 bytes per pixel, up to 2448*2048*2 bytes (TLBC2.py:1513-1517); the action returns it as a raw artifact with media type application/vnd.thorlabs.tlbc2.raw; bytesPerPixel=1|2. NOT COVERED: the 2D profile arrays from get_profiles and the byte order/interpretation of the raw pixel stream; the catalogue camera and format inputs are not exposed by the capture binding (one camera, raw format); the image is not [...]

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6, a model and not a human, 2026-11-02; reviewed_by stays null): BLOCKED; the preceding author notes describe the preserved pre-review implementation and are superseded by this paragraph. Fixed the undersized native image allocation, unowned raw image files, active-call close/teardown races, automatic reuse after terminal close, unsigned integer narrowing and factory cleanup ownership. The producer now requires an endpoint command artifact publisher before native mutation and returns its authorized URI; it preserves complete raw8/raw16 bytes without endian/calibration/PNG claims. The native buffer is always the sourced 2448*2048*2 bytes. A shared admission fence prevents queued native calls after stop and defers exactly-once session/SDK cleanup until active calls really settle; no thread is killed and pending/failed cleanup never acknowledges a safe state. Reset cannot reopen the closed session: upstream explicitly requires reinitialization. The fake shares that lifecycle and uses a valid 64x48 placeholder geometry. A retained DLL-directory object is explicitly closed after SDK cleanup; lost ownership leaks registration in CPython, not a proven premature DLL unload. Normal native wrapper methods already raise for negative statuses; no ignored-status finding is claimed. All21 focused native/stock-server tests and9 package non-gate cases pass. Five production capture-to-artifact/MCP cases pass on the private unmerged image-artifact SDK v2, including exact10027008-byte source-sized retrieval through the actual stdio writer under an explicit bounded quota, default quota refusal, malformed/readback failures and cleanup. Current actual-SDK G6/G8 still fail: artifact support is unmerged, and TSAFE-001/SAFE-014 require reset/reuse that the sourced terminal close cannot honestly provide. The check_driver harness and full primary measurement/configuration scope remain intact; no gate waiver, automatic reinitialization or fake-only pass was introduced. SDK integration and terminal-stop conformance applicability require separate review. Hardware/DLL deployment, independent physical stop, byte order and source installation remain unverified; no hardware or human review is claimed. Changed files: driver.py, native.py, new session.py, fake.py, facts.md, test_driver.py, reference.json, REFERENCE.md, RESULT.json and check-report.json.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): PASS after repair; supersedes the SDK_BUG block. With the SDK's declared terminal e-stop (CORE-087, SAFE-048; MHS/changes/RE-ENABLE-AND-TERMINAL-STOP.md), every reset after this endpoint's e-stop is refused RESET_REFUSED terminal_estop with the declared reason and no bridge call, the latch is kept, and the suite gives later tests a new endpoint. estop_terminal states the upstream facts (a closed session must be reinitialized, TLBC2.py:229-239; open() resets and initializes the instrument, TLBC2.py:201-208, a Fact added after review s7) and the policy (only a new native session on a new endpoint recovers it). The @reset hook that refused every reset is dropped; the closing state stays irreversible; no reopen, no faked reset success. G1-G9 pass, no finding; 13 cases pass. Changed driver.py, facts.md, test_driver.py, reference.json, REFERENCE.md, RESULT.json, check-report.json. Pin, authorship and driver.lock.json unchanged. No DLL, Windows, hardware or human review.

catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class carries the 4-sigma beam widths, centroid, peak, saturation, total power and sensor temperature together for a sensor.camera. cap.sensing.image.v1 carries only the image artifact; cap.measure.intensity.v1 is one intensity and binds only instrument.spectrometer and sensor.optical.
